AGENCY BRIEF – CARDIOVASCULAR TEAM OF NOVARTIS INDIA

Background & Context:
Novartis is looking to onboard a strategic creative and marketing agency partner to support the integrated promotion of three cardiovascular brands under a portfolio-led approach.

Brand(s) Overview:
1.	Sybrava (Inclisiran)
•	Recently launched (January 2024) first-in-class siRNA therapy
•	Indication: LDL-C reduction
•	Strategic role: Growth driver and primary focus
•	Core challenge: Drive awareness, adoption, and conviction among HCPs

2.	Pelacarsen
•	Pre-launch asset
•	Focus: Reduction of Lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)]

3.	Vymada (sacubitril valsartan)
•	Mature brand; completed 10 years in India
•	Patent expired

Overall Objective:
Develop and execute a portfolio-led marketing strategy that integrates messaging across the cardiovascular continuum.

Target Audience:
•	Cardiologists (primary)
•	Endocrinologists
•	Physicians/Internal Medicine Specialists
